item.description:
Added

  • Timer: lengths down to the second. Click the custom chip to pick it; click it again to type a length like a microwave (45 is 0:45, 230 is 2:30; Return to set, Esc to cancel). The arrows step 5 seconds under a minute and a whole minute above it. Recent lengths keep their seconds.
  • Timer: recent lengths. Every countdown you start is remembered — newest first, no repeats, presets left out, last four kept — as chips beside the presets.
  • Music and a timer together in the closed notch. Album art and the visualizer on the left, the countdown on the right. Hover or click the left half to open music, the right half to open the timer.
  • Auto-updates from this fork. Builds from this fork's releases now check this fork's own signed update feed instead of upstream's.

Changed

  • Timer: the custom chip keeps its own number when you pick a preset, and the arrows step from whatever is selected — 25m then up gives 26m.
  • Timer: every duration chip is the same size, custom one included.

Fixed

  • The timer ring moves smoothly and matches the time exactly. It used to step once a second, and its rounded ends made 50% look like ~52%. The countdown also ends on the dot instead of up to a second late.
  • A finished timer no longer stays open on every monitor. Once you hover it on one, the pop-ups on the others close.
  • Lyrics no longer load for the wrong song. Results are matched by track length, so a remix or cover with the same title isn't picked.
  • The current lyric line stays centered. Wrapped lines used to push it steadily toward the bottom of the panel.
  • Scrolling through lyrics underlines the line you're on, like Spotify.
  • Spotify's progress bar no longer runs ~0.2s ahead of the audio.
